summary.zh-CN: 代码审计、安全设计评审（ASVS）、STRIDE 威胁建模、扫描结果复核、修复验证与 Web 测试计划；不执行主动测试。
summary.en: Code audit, ASVS design review, STRIDE threat modeling, scan triage, fix verification and web test planning; no active testing is performed.

now.zh-CN: 审计某一版本的代码，给出文件行号、调用链证据、CWE 与修复建议
now.en: Audit a given version of the code with file and line, call-chain evidence, CWE and fixes

now.zh-CN: 按 ASVS 章节评审设计，按 STRIDE 建立威胁模型
now.en: Review designs against ASVS chapters and build STRIDE threat models

now.zh-CN: 复核 SAST/SCA/DAST 结果、去重定级并验证修复
now.en: Triage SAST/SCA/DAST results, dedupe, prioritise and verify fixes

now.zh-CN: 按 WSTG 编写 Web 测试计划与发现记录
now.en: Write WSTG-based web test plans and findings records

needs.zh-CN: 锁定版本的代码、架构文档或扫描报告
needs.en: Code at a locked version, architecture documents or scan reports

needs.zh-CN: Web 测试需书面授权范围与停止联系人
needs.en: Web testing needs written scope and a stop contact

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你上传的代码、文档与报告
permissions.en: Reads only the code, documents and reports you upload

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：推送代码、提交外部工单、执行任何主动测试
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: pushing code, filing external tickets or running any active test

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-25 已用真实模型验证代码审计：对合成样例给出带行号、CWE、置信度与修复验证方法的发现。
conditions.en: Code audit verified with a real model on 2026-09-25: findings on a synthetic sample include line numbers, CWE, confidence and fix verification.

conditions.zh-CN: 只做静态分析与计划；主动测试需另行授权的隔离环境。
conditions.en: Static analysis and planning only; active testing needs a separately authorised isolated environment.
